audit_member_text: Parallel locals nreq, ll, l, myvar, and mybeta are declared at L661-L664 but not assigned or referenced through L1272.

base_member_text: Comment block L215-219 states the masked-cell loop was extended to Jbeg-1..Jend+1 per Jeff but that the routine still does not check whether a point adjacent to an inter-processor boundary (in ghost cells owned by another processor) is land — the code at L221-293 relies on exchanged MASK ghosts (EXCHANGE L459-461) and the flag guards L226-230 etc.; whether this fully resolves the described flux-modification problem is not decidable from this file

VTYPE=4 ghost treatment zeroes cross-derivative ghosts on y-sides with the in-code admission 'this one is not an exact solution' (L1070); no caller in this file uses VTYPE=4,5,6 — callers of PHI_COLL here use only VTYPE 1,2,3 (L312-511), so the users of types 4-6 are elsewhere

In BOUNDARY_CONDITION the serial (non-COUPLING) west branch skips the wall for WaveMaker ABS/LEFT_BC_IRR (L83-93) but the COUPLING west branch (L66-81) applies the wall unconditionally — cross-branch asymmetry between L66-81 and L83-93

PHI_COLL periodic MPI exchange (L676-721) uses blocking MPI_SEND before the matching MPI_IRECV is guaranteed posted (tag 0, MPI_COMM_WORLD); correctness relies on MPI buffering/ordering across the DO II=1,PX loop
EXCHANGE converts integer MASK through REAL array rMASK for the periodic PHI_COLL call (L459-461); rounding behavior of the real-to-integer copy-back at L461 for exchanged ghost values is implicit
Fixed arrays EtaRxR/EtaRxL/EtaRyR/EtaRyL, Depthx/Depthy, Gamma3, Gamma2, MinDepthFrc, filter_interval, DISP_TIME_LEFT, IN_DOMAIN_*, Kstart_*/Kend_* come from GLOBAL/PARAM modules defined elsewhere

audit_member_text: PHI_COLL first installs periodic y ghost cells when PERIODIC is true at L669-L759, but only the VTYPE 1-3 y-boundary blocks are guarded by .NOT.PERIODIC (L801-L1027); the VTYPE 4-6 y blocks at L1032-L1266 subsequently zero, mirror, or negate those periodic ghosts, so PERIODIC is ineffective for those selector values.

BOUNDARY_CONDITION loops over Ibeg-1:Iend+1 and Jbeg-1:Jend+1 at L221-L293, then accesses MASK(I-1,J) at L235, P(I+1,J) at L241, MASK(I+1,J) at L252, Q(I,J+1) at L275, and MASK(I,J+1) at L287; this requires at least two valid ghost layers but the subroutine contains no Nghost/range check.

The CARTESIAN branch of EXCHANGE_DISPERSION conditionally exchanges time-dispersion fields ETAT/ETATx/ETATy or Ut/Vt and their derivatives inside Gamma2>ZERO (L328-L376), while the non-CARTESIAN branch L380-L411 has no corresponding time-field exchanges, leaving compile-time branches with different halo-update interfaces.

PHI_COLL accepts arbitrary VTYPE at L653 but has only independent IF blocks for values 1 through 6 (L763-L1266) and no rejection/default path; an out-of-range selector silently skips local physical-boundary fills before the parallel phi_exch call at L1269.
